TextView.android:text: Manage your DUET undergraduate admission application from one place.
Time allocation according to the admission test pattern.
All conditions must be satisfied to qualify for merit consideration.
The overall 40%, English MCQ 20%, and separate 35% requirement for each paper must all be satisfied.
Application fee is Tk. 1,500. Payment can be made through the available payment methods.
Applicants must satisfy the required academic and diploma technology conditions.
Keep your applicant photo, signature, identity document and applicable quota document ready.
